details:
Q1. Which part of this repository should be improved?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan / implement workflows
B. Review autofix / conflict resolution
C. Orchestrator / judge / validation workflows
D. Documentation / templates / repo configuration
E. A specific file, script, or workflow path - name it. (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix broken behavior or a regression
B. Improve reliability / reduce flakes
C. Improve speed / reduce API or token cost
D. Improve logs / alerts / docs / developer usability
E. Another specific outcome - describe it in one sentence. (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What concrete example should guide the change?
Choices:
A. I can paste a failing workflow run, log excerpt, or exact error message. (RECOMMENDED)
B. I can describe the current behavior and the expected behavior in 1-3 sentences. (RECOMMENDED)
C. I can link an existing issue, PR, or workflow run that shows the problem.
D. I do not have a concrete example; use best judgment in the selected area. (May require re-clarification.)
